API.run: run(plan_path,output_path=None)->summary; actual root release/source marker required
API.resume: Same command; own input/label/scaler transactions, committed arm results and last.pt model/Adam/all RNG/order/exposures plus cumulative arm/stage costs are preserved; no budget reset

runtime_protocol.case_order: Independent Python Random(2026) shuffled balanced TRAIN3 passes, exactly shared
runtime_protocol.model: Original PointNet(32,64) + scalar 67->256->256->256->256->1 ReLU; same constructor, seed, actual initial named trainable hashes
runtime_protocol.physical_features: FP64 original zero physical_u derivative and accepted 4Q gradients/weights -> Hooke sigma6 -> quadrature mean -> full10 incidence volume/10 recovery
runtime_protocol.new_feature_guards: finite/positive weights/partition1e-9/affine1e-9/symmetry1e-12/constant1e-12/GRID and canonical row identity/mask coverage
runtime_protocol.complete_case_loss: allN scalar encoded MSE sum/N, chunk32768 with context leaf accumulation then one original context backward and one Adam
runtime_protocol.first_actual_acceptance: all trainable grads present finite, encoder/head/context norms positive; exact-zero input-column gradients permitted; actual public counts/hash recorded
runtime_protocol.scalers: Two distinct shared TRAIN3-only fits: valid sigma6 mean/std floor1e-8 MPa and signed S abs q90 scale floor1e-12, asinh mean/std floor1e-8
runtime_protocol.DEV_read_barrier: Both arms completed120 and all four physical allN DEV prediction records persisted/stat-checked; then one shared stress member read per DEV
runtime_protocol.label_member: stress only; original displacement is never accessed; physical prediction array reads are separate from GT displacement reads
runtime_protocol.actual_label_receipts: Persistent read-start/read-completed/committed own cache; interrupted exposure is counted and silently repeating a missing committed label read is rejected
runtime_protocol.budgets: 900 cumulative stage seconds, 300 cumulative normal case load/H2D/full update seconds per arm; no new case/update after expiry, finite finalization overshoot explicit
runtime_protocol.checkpoint: last.pt every complete case including initial0, step120.pt; model/Adam/Python+NumPy+Torch+CUDA RNG/step/order/exposure/history/pass costs
runtime_protocol.incomplete: outer completed marks bounded scientific stage ended; actual arm step<120/incomplete and null or missing metrics reject gate

summary_schema.config_contract: request_contract returned contract, with plan_science five frozen recipe blocks
summary_schema.validation: per_case stress_relative_l2/RMSE_MPa/MAE_MPa/max_abs_error_MPa/hotspot_relative_l2/hotspot_zero_reference/zero_reference/num_nodes plus mean/worst and fixed denominator2
summary_schema.selection_gate: fixed2, both complete120, each tensor DEV signedS relativeL2<.25, mean reduction>=.20,worst ratio<=1.05, mean hotspot reduction>=.10; null or zero-reference relatives never pass

cost_policy.direct_zero_slots: Normal input/cloud preparation + separately timed cells-only incidence mask + actual fixed120 model load + fullN inference/decode/persistence; no physical solve or tensor recovery charged
cost_policy.physical_tensor_slots: Inherited original GT-free physical cold solve/setup + measured tensor recovery + mask/neural input/model load/fullN inference phases
cost_policy.shared_experiment_preparation: Separate oneoff stage costs, not charged as direct physical deployment work

limitations: No actual arrays, first full-case gradient or resource/accuracy checks executed by author
TRAIN3/DEV2/ver rough information screen, not family-wide elimination or geometry/load generalization
Approximate constitutive tensor is an input proxy; no exporter sign/recovery formula or scalar von-Mises assumption
No OptiStruct exactness, engineering qualification or final four-field solver choice
Original physical U accuracy is not reopened or assigned as scalar-model accuracy
Actual stage gate failure closes frozen recipe without rescue width/seed/loss/sign-rule/budget searches
